tutorials.title: How to make this year-in-review stats story using Claude
tutorials.trend: Spotify Wrapped vychází začátkem prosince a lidi už teď sdílí vlastní 'wrapped' recapy; vlastní design, žádné logo Spotify.
steps: Give Claude your year in five numbers.
Ask for an animated story recap with bold colors and big stats.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this Black Friday price drop animation using Claude
tutorials.trend: Black Friday je 27. 11., všechny značky a malé shopy teď hledají sale reels; animace přeškrtnuté ceny je typický formát.
steps: Tell Claude your product, old price and new price.
Ask for a bold sale animation where the price gets slashed.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this 3D Christmas tree of your photos using Claude
tutorials.trend: Začíná vánoční sezóna (advent 29. 11.), na IG se šíří 'photo memory' edity; 3D stromek z vlastních fotek v three.js.
steps: Give Claude ten of your favourite photos.
Ask for a spinning 3D tree where every ornament is a photo.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this northern lights sky over your city using Claude
tutorials.trend: Polární záře v listopadu znovu plní feedy (silné sluneční maximum); kreslená noční silueta tvého města s animovanou aurorou.
steps: Tell Claude your city and its skyline.
Ask for a night sky with slow, glowing northern lights.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this vintage Christmas film from your photo using Higgsfield
tutorials.trend: Retro 'old family Christmas tape' edity (VHS / 8mm look) jsou každý prosinec virální na TikToku a IG; foto se oživí do krátkého filmu.
steps: Upload one family photo to Higgsfield.
Pick a video model and ask for a warm 8mm Christmas film look.
Higgsfield builds it, you tweak it.
